obaddha: [ava + badha + ta. ] (ti) CL=7 [Ava + baddha + ṇa] (1) One who should distrub and afflict. (Disturbance. Bhāsāṭī.) (2) Should be bound and tied.
obandha: [u + bandha + ṇa] (ti) CL=7 Should be tied on. See below.
obandhapiṇḍita: [obandhapiṇḍa + ita] (ti) CL=7 One who has a lump of flesh that is like a bunch of fruits that should be tied on. See - Ovaddhapiṇḍika.
obandhitvā: [ava + bandha + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having tied up.
obhagga: [ava + bhanja + ta. ] (ti) CL=7 [Avabhagna(saṃ)] (1) Bent or crooked. (2) One who has a bent back or a hunch-back. (3) (A) Should be broken and destroyed. (B) Breaks down. (4) Should be bent.
obhaggajaṅgha: [obhaggā + jaṅghā] (ti) CL=7 One who has a broken leg.
obhaggapadālita: [obhagga + padālita] (ti) CL=7 Should be broken and destroyed.
obhaggasarīra: [obhagga + sarīra] (ti) CL=7 One who has a bent back.
obhaggavibhagga: [obhagga + vibhagga] (ti) CL=7 (A) Broken and crushed in disorder. (B) Wrinkles and creases.
obhaggavibhaggasākha: [obhaggavibhaggā + sākhā] (ti) CL=7 The branches (of a tree) that are broken and crushed in disorder.
obhaggavibhaggatā: [obhaggavibhagga + tā] (thī) CL=7 As a creased robe. (As a faded cloth or robe. Sya. 1. 699.)
obhaggobhagga: [obhagga. Vicchāpuda] (ti) CL=7 (1) Should be broken down. (2) Should be bowed down.
obhaggobhaggasākhābhaṅga: [obhaggobhagga + sākhābhaṅga] (pu) CL=7 A broken branch that should be broken down.
obhatacumbaṭaka: [obhata + cumbaṭa + ka] (ti) CL=7 A headpad that should be put down or removed. (a wife) who is taking someone and removing her head pad.
obhaujitvā: [ava + bhanja + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having folded.
obhaujāpetvā: [ava + bhanja + ṇāpe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having caused to fold.
obhaṭa: [obhaṭa (ta) + cumbaṭa] (ta) cumbaṭa (ti) CL=7 A headpad that should be put down or removed. One who is taken by removing her head pad, (a wife). (A woman who is making a living by using a head pad and taking something and selling (a small-scale vendor selling vegetables, etc.,), a man who should be taking her as a wife and causing her to give up her work).
obheti: [ava + ubha + ṇe + ti.] (kā, kri) CL=7 [Nīti, dhā. 129. Dhātvattha. 31.] Causes to fill.
obhoga: [ora + bhoga. ] (pu) CL=7 [Pācita, yo. 220. Ava + bhuja + ghaṇa. Obhujanaṃ obhogo. Nirutti, nhā. 542.] A coil. A fold. (inside the fold of a robe. pācita, yo.)
obhujitvā: [ava + bhuja + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 (A) Having curled. Having wrinkled. (B) Having coiled.
obhāsa: [ava + bhāsa + a(ṇa)] (ti) CL=7 Speaking coarsely with a variety of rude words. Insults. (Praise or reproach or asking (to get), etc., the sexual intercourse such as the sexual organs by the power of taṇhārāga).

[ava + bhāsu(bhāsa)+a(ṇa).] (pu) CL=7 [Nīti,dhā.181. Dhātvattha. 268. Obhā-sati dippatīti obhāso. Dhāna, ṭī. 37. Avabhāsa (saṃ)] (1) A bright color. Light. Color. Ruby color. Kasiṇa color. Light of dibba cakkhuñāṇa. Red color, white color, etc., (Four colors = moonlight, sunlight, firelight, and wisdom light. Aṃ, 1. 457.) (2) The body that is completed with an aureole. The light of the body. Appearance. (3) Shining. (4) A shape. A hint. (maaū, sya.). Gives a hint.  (bhāsā, ṭī.) (A) Gives a hint by deception. Shows one"s desire as a hint. (B) Shows a hint. Shows clearly one"s desire with a sign.
obhāsabhūta: [obhāsa + bhūta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Arises radiance. One who reaches a state of brightness or shining. (2) happens by appearing radiance or brightness. (3) Happens by showing radiance clearly.
obhāsagata: [obhāsa + gata] (ti) CL=7 (A) Reached or attained the wisdom light. (B) Arises together with the wisdom light.
obhāsagāthā: [obhāsa + gāthā] (thī) CL=7 A verse that is chanted by shining of the body. A verse that is preached by sending the radiance.
obhāsajāta: [obhāsa + jāta] (ti) CL=7 (A) One who has the wisdom radiance. (B) Arises the radiance. The radiance that is shining is as bright as one thousand moons and one thousand suns.
obhāsaka: [obhāsa + kara + kvi] (ti) CL=7 (Lord Buddha) who is an illuminator.
obhāsakara: [obhāsa + kara + ṇa] (ti) CL=7 (A) (Lord Buddha) who makes the wisdom light. (B) (Lord Buddha) who makes radiance.
obhāsakaraṇa: [obhāsa + karaṇa] (na) CL=7 (1) Makes radiance. (2) Radience that should be made.
obhāsakaraṇaṭṭha: [obhāsakaraṇa + attha]  CL=9 The meaning of light made (by ones" causes.) (Pārā, gaṃ, Thit.) the meaning of what is brought about as light (by ones" causes. (Adhippāyattha.)
obhāsakiccakaraṇa: [obhāsakicca + karaṇa] (na) CL=7 Making the function of radiance.
obhāsamaṇḍala: [obhāsa + maṇḍala] (na) CL=7 The circle of light or radiance.
obhāsamaṇḍalārammaṇa: [obhāsamaṇḍala + ārammaṇa] (ti) CL=7 Senses or concentrates on the circle of light.
obhāsamuucana: [obhāsa + muucana] (thī, na) CL=7 Emits radiance or light.
obhāsamāna: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + a + māna] (ti) CL=7 One who is shining.
obhāsana: [ava + bhāsa + yu] (ti) CL=7 (He) speaks coarsely. He insults.

[ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + yu. ] (thī, na) CL=7 [See - Obhāsati 2]. (1) Shining. (2) Causes to shine. (3) Shows clearly. (4) Light. Radiance. (5) Gives hint by deception. Shows his desire indirectly. (Ti) (6) Shine. (7) Causes to shine.
obhāsanahetu: [obhāsana + hetu] (pu) CL=7 A cause of shining.
obhāsanaka: [obhāsana + ka] (ti) CL=7 Causes to shine. See below.
obhāsanakacuṇtha: [obhāsanaka + cuṇṇa] (na) CL=7 A powder that causes to brighten. A facial powder.
obhāsanakicca: [obhāsana + kicca] (na) CL=7 The function of brightness.
obhāsanalakkhaṇa: [obhāsana + lakkhaṇa] (ti) CL=7 With the sign of showing clearly.
obhāsanarasa: [obhāsana + rasa] (ti) CL=7 The function of showing clearly or the function of pointing out.
obhāsanasabhāva: [obhāsana + sabhāva] (ti) CL=7 The nature of shining.
obhāsanavatthu: [obhāsana + vatthu] (na) CL=7 The subject of speaking coarsely.
obhāsanaṭṭha: [obhāsana + attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of shining or brightness.
obhāsanimitta: [obhāsa + nimitta] (na) CL=7 (1) The sign that is radiance. Shows radiance clearly.
obhāsanimittakamma: [obhāsanimitta + kamma] (na) CL=7 The function of showing radiance clearly.
obhāsanimittuppādana: [obhāsanimitta + uppādana] (na) CL=7 Causes to the sign of radiance.
obhāsanta: [ava + bhāsa + anta] (ti) CL=7 Speaks coarse words (sound). One who speaks coarsely.
[ava + bhāsu (bhāsa) + ṇe + anta] (ti) CL=7 Causes to shine.
obhāsante: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + a + ante] (kri) CL=7 They shine. See - Obhāsati 2.
obhāsaparittatā: [obhāsaparitta + tā] (thī) CL=7 As a state of a sign that is brightness which is small. A state of a sign that is a weak radiance.
obhāsare: [ava+bhāsu (bhāsa) + a + ante] (kri) CL=7 They shine. See - Obhāsati 2.
obhāsarūpa: [obhāsa + rūpa] (na) CL=7 The form of light.
obhāsasampatti: [obhāsa + sampatti] (thī) CL=7 Perfection of light or radiance.
obhāsasi: [ava + bhāsa + a + si] (kri) CL=7 You speak rude words. He speaks making fun. He insults. See - Obhāsati 1.
[ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + a + si] (kri) CL=7 You shine. See - Obhāsati 2.
[ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇe + si.] (kri) CL=7 You cause to shine.
obhāsate: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + a + te] (kri) CL=7 He shines. See - Obhāsati 2.
[ava + bhāsu (bhāsa) + ṇe + te] (kā, kri) CL=7 He causes to shine.
obhāsati: [ava + bhāsa + a + ti] (kri) CL=7 He speaks coarsely. He insults. ((Someone) who praises or reproaches or asks (wants to get) for concerns with sexual intercourse as well the vaccamagga massāvamagga, as well a part of the body, etc.,).
[ava + bhāsu (bhāsa) + a + ti. ] (kri) CL=7 [(nīti, dhā. 181. Dhātvattha. 268.) avabhāၑti (saṃ)] He shines. See also - Obhāsita.
obhāsatu: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + a + ante] (kri) CL=7 May he shine. See - Obhāsati 2.
obhāsavissajjana: [obhāsa + vissajjana] (thī, na) CL=7 Emits or sends the body"s light.
obhāsavissajjanapubbaka: [obhāsa vissajjana + pubbaka.] (ti) CL=7 [In thī.... Pubbikā.] Makes first sending the radiance. See - Obhāsagāthā.
obhāsayamāna: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇaya + māna] (ti) CL=7 (1) One who is shining. (2) One who causes to shine.
obhāsayanta: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇaka + anta.] (ti) CL=7 [In thī obhāsayantī.] (1) One who is shining. (2) One who causes to shine.
obhāsayate: [ata + bhāsu(bhāsa)+ṇaya + te] (kā, kri) CL=7 Causes to shine.
obhāsayitvā: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa)+ṇaya + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having caused to shine.
obhāsañāṇa: [obhāsa + ñāṇa] (na) CL=7 The wisdom that is a cause of radiance.
obhāsaṭṭha: [obhāsa + attha] (pu) CL=7 The meaning of radiance.
obhāsenta: [ava + bhāsa + ṇe + anta] (ti) CL=7 One who speaks making fun and insults. See also - Obhāsanta.
[ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇe + anta.] (ti) CL=7 [In thī obhāsentī.] (1) One who causes to shine. (2) One who shows (the sensual desire).
obhāsenti: [ava + bhāsa + ṇe + anti] (kri) CL=7 They speak coarsely. See - Obhāseti 1.
[ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇe + anti] (kā, kri) CL=7 They cause to shine. See - Obhāseti 2 (1).
obhāsentu: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇe + antu] (kā, kri) CL=7 May they cause to shine. See - Obhāseti 2 (1).
obhāseti: [ava + bhāsa + ṇe + ti] (kri) CL=7 (He) speaks rude words. (He) speaks coarsely. He speaks making fun. He insults.
[ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇe + ti] (kā, kri) CL=7 (1) He causes to shine. (2) He causes to show clearly. He shows.
obhāsetuṃ: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To cause to shine.
obhāsetvā: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇe + tvā] (kri, vi) CL=7 Having shined.
obhāseyya: [ava + bhāsa + eyya] (kri) CL=7 He should speak coarsely. He should speak making fun. He should insult. See - Obhāsati 1.
[ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇe + eyya] (kā, kri) CL=7 He should cause to shine. See - Obhāseti2 (1).
obhāsi: [ava + bhāsa + ī] (kri) CL=7 He spoke rude words. He spoke making fun. He insulted. See - Obhāsati 1.
[ata + bhāsa + iṃ] (kri) CL=7 I spoke rude words. I spoke making fun. I insulted. See - Obhāsati 1.
obhāsissati: [ava + bhāsa + ssati] (kri) CL=7 He will speak coarsely. He will speak to make fun. He will insult. See - Obhāsati 1.
obhāsita: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ta] (ti) CL=7 (1) Caused to show clearly. Should be shown. (2) Should be shined. (3) Shine.
obhāsitabba: [ava + bhāsa + tabba] (ti) CL=7 Should be spoken coarsely. One who should be spoken to making fun and insulted.
obhāsitanaccadassanasukha: [obhāsitanacca dassana + sukha] (na) CL=7 The pleasure or happiness of seeing radiance.
obhāsitatta: [obhāsita + tta] (na) CL=7 As a state of causing to shine.
obhāsituṃ: [ava + bhāsa + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To talk rude words.
obhāsitādesadisa: [obhāsitā + asesadisā] (ti) CL=7 Should be shined in all directions. One who causes to shine in all directions.
obhāsiṃ: [ata + bhāsa + iṃ] (kri) CL=7 I spoke rude words. I spoke making fun. I insulted. See - Obhāsati 1.
obhāsūpaṭṭhānakusala: [obhāsūpaṭṭhāna + kusala] (ti) CL=7 One who is skillful in the appearance of wisdom light.
obhāsetu: [ava + bhāsu(bhāsa) + ṇe + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To cause to shine.
obhāsitu: [ava + bhāsa + tuṃ] (bya) CL=7 To talk rude words.
